wages.text: His campaign supports workers’ right to organize for better wages.
wages.quote: He also calls for reining in health care costs and supporting workers’ rights to organize for better wages.

housing.text: He named building more housing as a top-three issue and said government has a responsibility to ensure people are housed.
housing.quote: I don't believe anybody should go without a roof over their head and we really — government has a responsibility to making sure that its people are housed.

tax.text: DeMaio is leading a campaign to defeat all 2026 tax increases and make future increases harder to enact.
tax.quote: “Californians are already forced to pay the highest taxes in the nation and we literally have seen millions of working families flee the high cost of our state – enough is enough,”

housing.text: DeMaio is campaigning to repeal state laws that loosen single-family zoning and limit local control over housing projects.
housing.quote: Reform California and Carl DeMaio are leading the charge to repeal SB9 and SB10 and other laws and regulations that limit local control and input on housing projects.

schools.text: DeMaio's reform plan proposes annual education vouchers that families could use to choose schools.
schools.quote: The only way to truly empower parents is to give them financial freedom to choose the best school for their child. This law would provide $13,000 annually in education vouchers for every student — starting with middle-class and low-income families and then expanding the program.

safety.text: DeMaio opposes defunding police and is campaigning to strengthen support for law enforcement.
safety.quote: Carl DeMaio and Reform California oppose any effort to defund the police and strongly Back The Blue!

sentencing.text: DeMaio's plan would repeal parts of Proposition 57 and prohibit early release for violent and repeat offenders.
sentencing.quote: This law would prohibit the early release of violent criminal and repeat offenders by repealing provisions of Prop 57 and prohibiting the placement of Sexually Violent Predators (SVPs) in residential communities.

immigration.text: DeMaio launched an initiative calling for State Guard deployment at the border, repeal of California's sanctuary law and an end to specified benefits for undocumented immigrants.
immigration.quote: To address the crisis and finally secure the border in California, Carl DeMaio and Reform California have released a 3-point “California Secure Borders” Initiative for emergency state action on the border crisis that includes:

abortion.text: DeMaio supports heartbeat legislation and barring taxpayer funding for abortions through the Hyde Amendment.
abortion.quote: DeMaio also supports the Heartbeat Bill and the Hyde Amendment to bar taxpayer funding from going to Planned Parenthood (or any other organization) for abortions.

health.text: In a 2014 questionnaire, he proposed interstate insurance purchasing, private management of exchanges and expanded health savings accounts.
health.quote: allowing individuals to buy health insurance across state lines

energy.text: DeMaio is campaigning against natural-gas appliance bans and mandatory home electrification retrofits because of their cost.
energy.quote: That’s why Carl DeMaio and Reform California are leading the statewide opposition to the costly new mandate.

voting.text: DeMaio's plan requires voter identification, citizenship verification, voter-list audits and enhanced ballot-signature reviews.
voting.quote: Starting with the 2026 election, this law requires a government-issued ID to vote, strengthens citizenship verification of voter registrations, requires audits of voter lists to ensure they are properly maintained, imposes penalties on counties that fail to count ballots on time, and enhances signature reviews on ballots.
